暴走 A Long Walk

2009年01月17日 Jan 17, 2009 · Ruxu-life · 1 分钟阅读 1 min read

by: MuMu

赶年底见了很多人

前天大家多数都指数下滑

08果然都与时俱进

相比之下还是有人罩着爽

貌似每年过年前总会有一天暴走

起点都是在积水潭

去年是跟大黄鸡精+云积水潭后海北海

今年跟花从新街口走到护国寺与小火和chh会合去了韩庚妈的梅X

满屋子的小女中学生感慨自己真是老了老了…

跑去前门,小白同学,传说中的铛铛车跟大连那个比起来性价比差远了…

不过路痴木今天才发现大栅栏居然就在前门大街-_-!!!

反复穿越各个地下通道

看了完整的发泄球

目光遍历天安门广场

本木终于跟阿花辗转到了西直门

见到了让人耳目一新的北站

——2年前跟小Q早晨顶着月亮去买票的景象犹如昨日

见到丫丫,美栅

本木难掩心中激动

直到最后在巴沟分别

p.s.:特别特别喜欢万的“本木生活”

AI-generated translation.

I saw a lot of people toward the end of the year.

The day before yesterday, most people’s mood indexes were dropping.

So 2008 really did move with the times.

Compared with that, it’s still great to have people looking out for you.

It seems like every year before the New Year there’s always one day of wild walking.

The starting point is always Jishuitan.

Last year it was Da Huang, Chicken Essence + Yun, from Jishuitan to Houhai to Beihai.

This year I walked with Hua from Xinjiekou to Huguosi, met up with Xiao Huo and chh, and went to Han Geng’s mom’s Mei X.

The room was full of little middle-school girls, and I couldn’t help sighing that I was really getting old, getting old…

Then we ran off to Qianmen. Classmate Xiao Bai, and that legendary Dangdang trolley car—compared with the one in Dalian, the cost-performance ratio was nowhere close…

But today this direction-blind MuMu only just discovered that Dashilan is actually right on Qianmen Street -_-!!!

We kept crossing through one underpass after another.

Saw the full venting ball.

Let my eyes sweep across Tiananmen Square.

At last I made my way with A Hua to Xizhimen.

And saw the newly refreshing North Railway Station.

—The scene from two years ago, when Xiao Q and I headed there at dawn under the moon to buy tickets, still feels like yesterday.

Saw Ya Ya and Mei Zha.

This MuMu could hardly hide the excitement inside.

Until finally we parted at Bagou.

p.s.: I especially, especially love Wan’s “MuMu Life.”
